thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx errors on /v1/stream (us-west-2). Automated severity: P1.

raj: seeing it too. clients reporting streaming disconnects + gateway 502s.

olivia: grabbed logs from gateway for last 10m, looks like chunked encoding resets + proxy upstream 502s.

sam: any customer impact? support?

maria: a few customers on Dedicated reported partial responses + aborted streams, opening tickets. timeline: starts ~ 09:12 PDT.

raj: triage plan: 1) on-call takeover 2) collect gateway/proxy logs 3) check model host health and kube pods 4) consider temporary fallback routing to standby region.

olivia: running quick query on edge logs:```
504 upstream read timeout from 10.0.4.22:502
chunked encoding: unexpected EOF
```

luis: I see increased tail latency on runtime pods; KV cache miss ratio up 3x. Could be cache eviction causing bigger model compute.

raj: Maria, please confirm which customers are impacted and severity. Sam, I need you to shadow the gateway metrics and rate-limits. Olivia, keep digging into connection reset patterns.

maria: Affected: AcmeCorp (prod), BrightNote (staging), several low-traffic eval jobs. AcmeCorp saw 10% request failures on streaming paths.

sam: Gateway metrics: spike in concurrent chunked connections ~ 09:10 -> 09:18. Error rate 5xx moved from 0.2% -> 6%. 502s cluster-wide, but some nodes worse. No recent deploys at 09:00.

olivia: Pulling nginx/access and proxy logs. Noting client side FIN before full response in many streams. Example snippet:```
"GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1" 502 - "-" "-" "upstream: "10.0.4.22:8080" "upstream_response_time: 0.113" "request_time: 6.214"
```

raj: That pattern usually means upstream closed connection early, maybe runtime crashed or OOM. Check model host pods for OOMKilled and last gc spikes.

luis: Runtime pods show elevated memory pressure on g3-pool-2; a couple restarts around 09:14 with SIGABRT. Core dump rotated.

olivia: Also seeing many client cancellations (client canceled while server sending chunked frames). Could be clients hitting timeout or network flaps.

sam: For live mitigation: options: a) temporarily remove problematic runtime nodes from LB b) route traffic to us-east standby c) reduce keepalive timeout at gateway to avoid accumulating half-open connections d) enable non-streaming fallback for critical customers. Thoughts?

raj: Prioritize minimizing customer impact: route AcmeCorp to standby region (b) and enable fallback (d) as safety net. Also drain problematic nodes (a).

olivia: K8s drain command ready:```
kubectl cordon node/g3-node-12
kubectl drain node/g3-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

luis: I can cordon the two nodes with restarts. Will also increase runtime logging to capture thread stacks.

maria: Notifying AcmeCorp support contact: "We’re actively mitigating a streaming outage; routing you to standby and enabling non-streaming fallback. ETA ~15m."

raj: Sam, start routing policy change. Use traffic-router to shift 100% of AcmeCorp service group to us-east-1 fallback pool.

sam: On it. traffic-router change:```
traffic-router set-route --service acmecorp --region us-east-1 --weight 100 --reason "live mitigation: us-west instability"
```

sre-bot: Deploy event: traffic-router change applied by sam at 09:26 PDT.

olivia: After routing shift we see error rate for AcmeCorp drop to ~0.5% on streams, but overall cluster still elevated due to background jobs.

luis: Drained nodes show repeated C10k style FD exhaustion logs. I’m increasing file descriptors and checking kernel tcp_tw_reuse. Running remediation:```
sysctl -w fs.file-max=2000000
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse=1
```

raj: Good. Also disable aggressive batching on runtime to reduce memory spikes: flip config flag.

olivia: Flipped batching to conservative:```
SET /runtime/config batching.max_batch_size=8 batching.idle_ms=10
```

sam: Observability: tail latency dropped after changes. 5xx rate across cluster down from 6% -> 1.2% in 7 minutes.

maria: Support update: AcmeCorp confirmed degraded but acceptable after switch; they're on standby till we confirm root cause.

raj: Next steps: 1) keep nodes drained and repro on staging 2) analyze core dumps + runtime OOM traces 3) harden chunked handling in gateway 4) post-incident follow-up (runbook amendments). Assign owners.

olivia: I’ll take core dump triage (olivia). luis: kernel/fd tuning + repro (luis). sam: routing/rollbacks and gating (sam). maria: customer comms. raj: incident lead and timeline + postmortem.

sre-bot: Incident severity lowered to P2 at 09:41 PDT after mitigation progress.

raj: If anything regresses, re-open P1. For now keep this thread for handoff notes and postmortem items. Good job team. :thumbsup:

maria: Leaving a note: check client SDKs for default shorter timeouts causing cancellations; might be masking server-side issues.

olivia: Also flag chunked-encoding edge-case where partial frames + connection reset lead to 502 translation at gateway. We'll add test in CI.

raj: I'll compile a timeline + action items and paste into incident tracker. End of live mitigation thread.
